unit.why: A single narrative about an elderly Russian sage who, while collecting alms, meets his former student, now an armed robber, and kills him through a halakhic ruse; no Hasidic figures appear.

stories.start_quote: ג) מעשה נפלא מה שאירע תלמיד
stories.end_quote: כזה כן זה לא נופל דבר
stories.summary_en: An old sage, fallen into poverty and collecting alms, is stopped in a forest by his former student, now a murderous highwayman. Using the principle 'one does not forsake the permitted for the forbidden' and 'if one comes to kill you, kill him first', he talks the robber into letting himself be struck once. After a prayer the sage stuns him and kills him with his own gun.
